name: Service Outage: The Break Room Goes Dark
read_aloud: SERVICE OUTAGE. Terminal offline. Vendors offline. Break Room rest unsupported.
layout: The Break Room with the lights half off, the terminal dark, the corkboard blank and a sign taped to the door: OUT OF ORDER, BOTH OF US.

exits.name: The rest of the route runs through Z8 to Z9.

features.name: No services: no terminal, no vendors, no corkboard. It is no longer a saferoom (decision 026); the Green Room is the only saferoom.

quick_run.setup: The Break Room is dark and the door sign reads OUT OF ORDER, BOTH OF US.
quick_run.decision: Spend the last of the supplies and say goodbye to the room, or walk past it?
quick_run.on_success: They leave with leftovers shared and no illusions about resting here.
quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler tries to rest here and finds it is no longer a saferoom.
quick_run.cut_short: Read the sign, say it is no longer a saferoom, and move on.

loot.text: Break Room services end today; no box ceremony or terminal.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
